edges.why: Decision step 1: FLASH_TISA_NOAA20 grids the NOAA-20 FLASHFlux SSF (through the internal hourly SSF1deg-HR files, which cite Version1B); CHILD of this collection. Version1A is the only TISA version in CMR.

Decision step 6: FLASHFlux SSF is produced with the CERES SSF production codes and parameter list, with no data dependency on the CERES SSF; the DQS describes Terra/Aqua, and the NOAA-20 counterpart is inferred; RELATED.

suite: MetadataAssociation RELATED → FLASH_SSF_NOAA20-FM6-VIIRS Version1A does not resolve (versions in CMR: ['Version1B']); it names another version of the same ShortName, which the lineage skills never list.
The DOI in the DATA SET LANDING PAGE URL misspells NOAA20 as "NOOA20": https://doi.org/10.5067/NOOA20/CERES/FLASH_SSF_FM6_VIIRS_L2.V1B
Granule attribute identifier_product_doi = '10.5067/NOAA20/CERES/SSF-FM6_L2.001A' is the DOI of the climate-quality CER_SSF_NOAA20-FM6-VIIRS (Edition1A), not of this FLASHFlux collection.
InputGranules list 115 internal file paths (FLASHFlux intermediates, calibration coefficient files, static ADM tables, MOA files); none is a CMR granule.

The linked Data Quality Summary is for Terra/Aqua MODIS Version4A and the Data Products Catalog is the 2004 CERES SSF R4V1; no NOAA-20 / VIIRS Version1B document is linked or listed on the CERES documentation page.

The abstract still says "CERES is currently producing world-class climate data products derived from measurements taken aboard NASA's Terra and Aqua spacecraft", and names GEOS-IT while the Version4A DQS describes GEOS FP-IT 5.12.4.
No association to FLASH_TISA_NOAA20 (its downstream product) or to CER_SSF_NOAA20-FM6-VIIRS; the TISA record has no associations either.
The GET RELATED VISUALIZATION (WORLDVIEW) link points to the CERES project logo image.
